title: MCRenaissance
description: A Mod to revert the controversial 1.9 combat update, while also expanding 1.12.2 with QoL features and new blocks that complete the game rather than bloat it.
body:
A Mod to revert the controversial 1.9 combat update, while also expanding 1.12.2 with QoL features and new blocks that complete the game rather than bloat it. For example adding missing wall, stair, fence variants for already existing blocks, etc.
